title: Sect Master's Gaze
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji raised his head toward the void, sensing the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. A cold spiritual sense transmitted: 'Found you.'

text.content: Ling Yuan knelt on the Arena Platform, trembling all over. His dominant aura that once swept across the world had long vanished. His robes were torn apart by sword energy, and his face still bore the red marks from Chen Ji's slap. He looked utterly miserable. The viewing platforms fell into dead silence, everyone too shocked to speak. Who could have imagined that Ling Yuan, the invincible prodigy of the Tianqing Sect, would be publicly crushed by a Servant Disciple?

dialogue.content: Impossible... Impossible! How could I lose to a废物!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his palm, his expression calm as if he had just done something trivial. He glanced at the kneeling Ling Yuan, the corner of his mouth slightly raised, revealing a meaningful smile. This smile, in Ling Yuan's eyes, cut deeper into his pride than any mockery. The Sect Master's face was as dark as standing water, his gaze shifting between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan, as if contemplating something.

dialogue.content: Senior Ling, you've been too courteous.

text.content: These words fell into everyone's ears, sounding particularly ironic. Too courteous? It was clearly a crushing defeat! The disciples on the viewing platform began whispering. Some were amazed, some were jealous, and more were re-examining this disciple who had always been viewed as废物. Yet Chen Ji seemed completely oblivious to all this, standing quietly in place, waiting for the awarding ceremony.

A moment later, a dignified voice came from the main seat: 'The competition has ended. First place, Chen Ji, step forward to receive your reward.' The Sect Master rose slowly, his dragon-like stride carrying an imposing aura of unspoken authority. In his hand was a jade pendant radiating soft light—the proof of first place in the Outer Court Competition, the pass to the Inner Sect. The surrounding disciples cast envious gazes. This was something countless Outer Disciples had dreamed of.

Chen Ji straightened his clothes and walked toward the high platform. His steps were neither hurried nor slow, each one planted steadily, as if he wasn't collecting a reward but simply taking a daily stroll. The Sect Master watched him, his gaze profound and unfathomable, seemingly trying to see through this youth's heart. When Chen Ji approached, the Sect Master suddenly spoke: 'Your strength seems greater than what appears on the surface.'

dialogue.content: Reporting to the Sect Master, this disciple was just lucky.

text.content: Upon hearing this, a glint of amusement flickered in the Sect Master's eyes. He didn't press further, simply handing the jade pendant to Chen Ji. At the moment their fingers were about to touch, Chen Ji suddenly felt an inexplicable chill surge up his spine—there was a pair of eyes, hidden in the shadows, filled with malice. He下意识地抬起头，扫视着看台上的每一张面孔，却什么也没有发现。

At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly began to tremble violently in Chen Ji's embrace. It felt like something was awakening, responding to a distant summons. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he could sense that the watching gaze did not come from any mortal. It was a power beyond the secular world, an existence capable of turning heaven and earth.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record issued a warning. Chen Ji must make a choice—risk investigating the source of that gaze, or stabilize the situation first?

choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, foresee the movements of that gaze's owner within the next three hours
choices.risk_hint: Excessive consumption of Heavenly Fate will intensify the backlash

text.content: Chen Ji secretly channeled a thread of spiritual energy into the Tianji Record Fragment. In an instant, the world before his eyes blurred. Images from the next three hours flashed through his mind like a carousel—he saw the owner of those eyes but only caught a vague silhouette, and a massive, slowly opening eye. That was no creature's eye, but... the Heavenly Dao itself.

choices.description: Do not consume Heavenly Fate, continue to act as if nothing happened, secretly watch for abnormalities in surroundings

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart, his face still maintaining that harmless smile. He bowed to thank the Sect Master, took the jade pendant, as if completely oblivious to that watching gaze. But the moment he turned, his spiritual sense spread quietly, carefully searching every trace of abnormality around him. Where did that gaze come from? He had to find out.

The Sect Master seemed to notice Chen Ji's unusual behavior, frowning slightly: 'Chen Ji, what's wrong?' Chen Ji quickly gathered his thoughts and respectfully replied: 'Reporting to the Sect Master, this disciple was just too excited and momentarily spaced out.' The Sect Master gave him a deep look, said nothing more, and merely waved his hand signaling Chen Ji could withdraw. But the moment Chen Ji turned, that gaze appeared again, and it was clearer, sharper than before.

The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in Chen Ji's embrace, as if encountering something terrifying. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly transmitted a fluctuation: 'Be careful... that's not an ordinary existence... it's the Heavenly Dao's Eye!' Chen Ji's heart tightened. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that terrifying truth that would only be revealed in Volume 8, actually appeared now? Cold sweat seeped down his back, yet his expression remained unruffled.

dialogue.content: Don't panic. It hasn't locked onto you yet. But it has noticed the aura of the Tianji Record...

text.content: Chen Ji descended the high platform slowly, each step feeling like walking on knife points. He could feel that gaze following him, like a hungry beast sizing up its prey. The surrounding disciples were still discussing the previous battle, none noticing Chen Ji's abnormality. Just then, a cold spiritual sense suddenly pierced through his Mental Sea: 'Found you...'

Chen Ji's footsteps paused slightly, then returned to normal. That spiritual sense was ice-cold and biting, carrying a high-and-mighty scrutiny, as if observing an ant. This was the Heavenly Dao's Eye—that existence surpassing everything, transmitting to him for the first time. Chen Ji's heart churned with waves, yet his expression changed not at all, still wearing that harmless demeanor.

choice.prompt: Facing the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, Chen Ji must decide the next move—proactively probe, or wait for the right moment?

choices.text: Proactively respond to the spiritual sense
choices.description: Attempt to communicate with the Heavenly Dao's Eye using spiritual sense, probe its intentions
choices.risk_hint: May expose identity, bringing catastrophic disaster

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his spiritual sense abruptly extending outward, attempting to establish contact with that cold spiritual sense. However, at the moment the two spiritual senses were about to collide, a terrifying force suddenly erupted, directly slamming his spiritual sense back into the depths of his Mental Sea. Chen Ji groaned, a trickle of blood appearing at his nose. He raised his head toward the void, yet his heart was unexpectedly calm—at least, he confirmed one thing: the Heavenly Dao's Eye had not yet discovered his true identity.

choices.description: Bury this matter deep in your heart, secretly seek countermeasures

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the impulse in his heart, burying that spiritual sense's fluctuation deep within. He walked back into the crowd composedly, even wearing a faint smile on his face. But in a corner where no one could see, his fists were already clenched tight. The Heavenly Dao's Eye... So from the beginning, he wasn't playing chess, but being watched by an even greater chess player. This discovery filled him with both fear and rage—but more than that, a determination to fight back from the brink.

The surrounding disciples rushed forward to congratulate him. Some slapped Chen Ji's shoulder to express admiration, while others watched from afar with jealous eyes. Su Qingyao stood in the crowd, her gaze complex as she watched Chen Ji. She was the only person in this sect who had sensed something abnormal. Now, looking at this youth once deemed废物, her doubts grew deeper. Yet Chen Ji merely smiled as he dealt with everyone, as if nothing had happened.

Their gazes briefly met in the air. Su Qingyao seemed to want to say something, but finally just nodded lightly and turned to leave. Chen Ji watched her retreating figure, a complex emotion rising in his heart. In this world, not many could sense his abnormalities, and Su Qingyao was one of them. He needed to be more careful—not only watching for the Heavenly Dao's Eye's scrutiny, but also dealing with this intelligent woman's investigations.

Night gradually fell. The competition finally concluded. The lights within the sect lit up one after another. The disciples dispersed in groups, discussing the day's wonders. Chen Ji stood alone in a corner of the Martial Arena, gazing at the pitch-black night sky above. His hand tightly gripped the Inner Sect pass, yet his mind was thinking of something far more important. The appearance of the Heavenly Dao's Eye had disrupted all his plans.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly emerged in the Mental Sea: 'Chen Ji, I told you long ago that the Tianji Record comes with a price. It's a double-edged sword. It can let you foresee the future, but it will also make you noticed by higher-level existences. Today's events are merely a beginning... From now on, you need to be even more cautious.' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then raised his head, a resolute glint flashing in his eyes: 'Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye has noticed me, I will no longer hide.'

dialogue.content: What are you planning to do?

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's mouth slightly raised, revealing a meaningful smile: 'Since it wants to play chess, I'll play along. But this time, I want to overturn the chessboard.' The moment his voice fell, commotion suddenly came from the distance. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. He turned to look and saw a group of black-robed disciples rushing toward the Martial Arena. The leader held a golden invitation, his expression arrogant: 'By the Sect Master's order, please Brother Chen Ji to the Council Hall for a discussion.'

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, examining these uninvited guests. Ordinary messenger disciples would never make such a show. This was clearly unfriendly. He quickly calculated in his heart—what was the Sect Master's real intention in summoning him immediately after the competition? Mere curiosity, or ulterior motive? More importantly, was this summons related to the Heavenly Dao's Eye's scrutiny from earlier? The night wind blew past, carrying a chill. Chen Ji took a deep breath and walked toward the direction of the Council Hall.

Night was as dark as ink, stars dim. Chen Ji walked alone through the sect's Corridor, behind him the footsteps of those black-robed disciples, rhythmic and沉闷, like escorting a prisoner. He composedly scanned his surroundings, imprinting every turning and every shadow into his mind. The Tianji Record Fragment remained slightly warm in his embrace, seemingly reminding him that danger had not yet passed. And the moment he was about to step into the Council Hall, that cold spiritual sense rang out once more—this time, clearer, more pressing: 'Found you...'
